Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Radio & TV | Relationships Make Me Stay: Joy Prime’s exciting new dating show premieres Nov. 1 Source : Joy Prime 30 October 2026 8:27pm Audio By Carbonatix
Can 60 seconds spark a lasting connection? Joy Prime ’s new dating reality show, Make Me Stay , is set to put first impressions, attraction and the search for love to the ultimate test when it premieres on November 1, 2026.
Finding love can be unpredictable, but what happens when you have just 60 seconds to make someone interested in you?
Designed to bring excitement, spontaneity and entertainment to the dating experience, Make Me Stay explores the power of first impressions and the possibility of finding a meaningful connection in an unexpected moment.
The show brings together singles looking for love and gives them an opportunity to introduce themselves, express their personalities and make a memorable impression. With just one minute to capture someone's interest, participants must find creative ways to stand out and convince a potential match that they are worth getting to know.
But beyond the fun, excitement and pressure of the 60-second encounters lies a bigger question: Can genuine attraction develop from a brief first meeting?
Make Me Stay promises viewers an entertaining look at modern dating, exploring attraction, confidence, communication and the different things people look for when choosing a potential partner.
From unexpected connections to interesting personalities and unpredictable moments, the show is set to offer viewers a refreshing perspective on the search for love.
As dating continues to evolve, Make Me Stay brings the conversation to television, challenging singles to step out of their comfort zones and discover whether one minute could be the beginning of something special.
With its premiere scheduled for November 1, 2026 at 8 P.M., viewers can look forward to a new dating experience filled with excitement, chemistry and the possibility of love.
Tune in to Joy Prime from 1st November and be part of the journey.
